# BluLavelle
> Handmade press-on nail marketplace. Stained-glass, 3D and custom-sized sets from independent nail artists. Reusable, salon-quality, applied in about 10 minutes.

## Facts
- Product: handmade reusable press-on nails, often 10-nail sets, with a glue or adhesive-tab kit
- Fit: sizing kit and custom measurements
- Wear time: more than 2 weeks with nail glue, or 3–7 days with adhesive tabs. Sets are reusable with care
- Free shipping: orders over $150
- Returns: request a return or exchange within 30 days of delivery. No restocking fee. Contact support@blulavelle.com
- Operator: Bluprinter LLC (US), 5900 Balcones Dr Ste 100, Austin, TX 78731, and Bluprinter LTD (UK), company number 16342615, 71-75 Shelton Street, Covent Garden, London WC2H 9JQ
- US warehouse: 1301 E Arapaho Rd, Ste 101, Richardson, TX 75081
- Support email: support@blulavelle.com
